content: this is a summary of a legal case in vilnius city district court the case involves a debt of €1361214 owed by the deceased person referred to as rb to a creditor referred to as ab the debt was recognized by the court and the claim was initially lodged by mrs b but it exceeded the time limit for claiming the claim was then transferred to the children of rb who are the defendants in this case the defendants jb and eb opposed the action and requested its dismissal claiming that the loan agreement was never made and that ab never demanded repayment they also argued that even if the loan existed rb had been making payments towards it however the court confirmed the existence of the loan agreement and recognized it as a personal obligation of rb the court found that the defendants were liable to pay the debt and dismissed their counterclaim the court ordered the defendants to pay the claimant the amount owed as well as the costs of the proceedings
